response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt::numeric / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT tradekind, cnt AS behaviour_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins on exact text equality drop behaviour records with no matching transaction or trader. Both join keys are primary keys, so each behaviour record is counted exactly once.

A NULL tradekind forms its own group, and GROUP BY keeps it as one group. The average share is taken over all groups, including the NULL group. If there are no groups, the average is missing and no rows are returned.
